title: ChainView
description: JSON Schema enforces record shapes, nonempty tasks, and whole-array uniqueness. It cannot compare task_id properties across tasks, require active_task_id or explicitly_activated_task_ids to name entries in tasks, or assert identifier ordering; ChainStateEvaluator must enforce those semantic relations. Schema conformance alone does not establish readiness, activation, or authorization.

explicitly_activated_task_ids.description: Whole-array duplicates are rejected here. Strict ordering and the cross-value subset relation to tasks[*].task_id are semantic-validator responsibilities.
